coordinate_convention: Pixel boxes are [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax] at native pixel edges, upper-left origin, half-open. WGS84 vertices are the exact transform of selected pixel-edge corners, not an assertion of subpixel annotation accuracy.
author: codex-ai-reviewer-s1
purpose: Independent raw-first AI review of the fixed April TRAIN primary. No model output consulted and no real accuracy or human-ground-truth claim.
ui_access: Registered numeric rasters and read-only SQLite; no review action saved.

first_pass_before_proposal_geometry.prior_context_review_exposure: The April target acquisitions were reviewed without accessing their detector outputs. Their February context acquisitions had been reviewed in earlier TRAIN work; complete independence from that prior context review is not claimed. No February detector output was newly opened in this task.

method: Inspected every nonzero target/context native 448-pixel panel and focal details, with identical fixed log-amplitude-DN display bounds: VV20..1000, VH10..300; not calibrated dB.
Inspected automatic masks and configured AOIs. No prediction count, score, geometry or overlay was read.
Published numeric mosaics were compared pixel-for-pixel with their applicable retained cores; all registered and retained source hashes passed.
Fondeo/canal scopes are marine; patios preserve terrestrial interior controls. Ambiguous waterfronts are excluded, not assigned vessel absence.
Partial-slice scope has a two-native-pixel guard at internal nodata boundaries. Components without a 5 m interior or a center pixel are withdrawn.
No family, length or width inferred. Absence of a confirmed boat never changes the selected acquisition.
consolidation_notes: These are raw-reference proposals only. Do not infer zero model proposals from existing_detections=[]: detector output was not accessed.
Root must adjudicate the proposed scopes and resolve every intersecting provisional proposal before setting scene_complete in the database.
A null scope must stay null; do not substitute the complete configured zone.
